annotations.title: Nordic Company Lookup: Norway and Finland Registers

description: Look up companies in the Norwegian and Finnish company registers by registration number or name: name, legal form, industry, address, registration date and status. Company-level data only, no persons. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

id.description: Organisation number (NO, 9 digits) or business ID (FI, e.g. 0112038-9).

limit.description: Maximum results for a name search.

name.description: Company name to search. Used if id is not set.

name: nordic_company_lookup
